items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...was it Gil Fuller - then kind of put the finishing touches on it. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: There’s a wonderful story where Al McKibbon talks about Manteca, how it came about, and he kind of does it in the voice of Chano Pozo, and it’s really quite cute there. But you know there was - it was a collective effort there. Because Chano had the idea, and then Dizzy and - was it Gil Fuller - then kind of put the finishing touches on it. Just to be there and experience that, cause this is new territory, forging new territory that hadn’t necessarily been part of the jazz landscape there.
